title: BridgeStart Housing Navigation
description: Synthetic housing navigation program offering coordinated-entry support, document preparation, and transitional housing referrals.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth; eligibility confirmed during intake
application_steps: Call or submit the online interest form; complete a 20-minute intake
what_to_bring: Photo ID if available; proof of foster care is helpful but not required for first call

title: Harbor Tonight Youth Shelter
description: Synthetic same-day youth shelter with meals, showers, charging, and next-day case navigation.
eligibility: Youth ages 18-24; call first to confirm bed availability
application_steps: Call the availability line before traveling; staff complete intake on arrival
what_to_bring: No documents required for the first night

title: Contra Costa Launch Housing
description: Synthetic transitional housing and landlord-navigation service for transition-age foster youth.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 18-25; placement depends on availability
application_steps: Complete a phone screening and meet a housing navigator
what_to_bring: ID and proof of income if available

title: California Housing Rights Line
description: Synthetic statewide information line explaining tenant rights, notices, deposits, and how to find local legal help.
eligibility: California residents ages 16-25 seeking housing-rights information
application_steps: Call during open hours or request a callback online
what_to_bring: Lease or notice if one exists; remove sensitive numbers before uploading
accessibility: TTY relay supported; phone and web access

title: Campus Bridge Scholars
description: Synthetic college support program with priority advising, book grants, tutoring, and a foster-youth liaison.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth enrolled or planning to enroll at a participating community college
application_steps: Book a welcome appointment; an advisor explains enrollment and financial aid
what_to_bring: No documents needed for the welcome appointment
address: 100 College Demo Way, Pleasant Hill, CA

title: Alameda Scholars Hub
description: Synthetic education navigation for applications, transcripts, financial aid, and campus foster-youth programs.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 16-26
application_steps: Choose a virtual or in-person appointment
what_to_bring: School login or transcript if available
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible; captions for virtual meetings

title: Next Chapter Scholarship Lab
description: Synthetic national virtual coaching program for scholarship searches and application essays.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth preparing for accredited education or training
application_steps: Create an account and reserve a coaching session
what_to_bring: Draft essay or list of goals if available

title: East Bay Career Launch
description: Synthetic job-readiness program offering paid workshops, resume help, interview practice, and employer introductions.
eligibility: Ages 18-24; priority for current and former foster youth
application_steps: Attend an orientation and choose a career track
what_to_bring: Photo ID and work authorization documents are needed before paid placement, not orientation

title: Contra Costa First Job Studio
description: Synthetic drop-in employment studio with laptops, printing, applications, and coaching.
eligibility: Youth ages 16-25
application_steps: Drop in or reserve a coach online
what_to_bring: Bring a work history if available; it is okay to start without one

title: California Benefits Navigator
description: Synthetic statewide benefits screening for food, healthcare, cash assistance, and local application support.
eligibility: California transition-age youth; final eligibility is determined by each benefit program
application_steps: Complete a confidential screening; choose which applications to pursue
what_to_bring: Income information helps but is not required to begin screening

title: Fresh Start Microgrant
description: Synthetic one-time flexible microgrant for urgent transportation, school, work, or document expenses.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 18-25; limited funds and documentation review apply
application_steps: Submit a short request and speak with a grant navigator
what_to_bring: Expense estimate and foster-care verification may be requested

title: Oak Tree Wellness Center
description: Synthetic trauma-informed counseling, peer groups, and short-term therapy for transition-age youth.
eligibility: Youth ages 16-25; insurance is not required for initial consultation
cost: Free initial consultation; sliding scale afterward
application_steps: Call or request a confidential consultation
what_to_bring: No documents needed for the first conversation

title: Calm Now Support Line
description: Synthetic 24/7 crisis support line for young adults who feel unsafe, overwhelmed, or at risk of self-harm.
eligibility: Anyone ages 16-26 needing immediate emotional support
application_steps: Call or text the support line
what_to_bring: Nothing required

title: Youth Health Access Clinic
description: Synthetic primary care, sexual health, vaccinations, and insurance navigation for transition-age youth.
eligibility: Youth ages 16-25; accepts uninsured patients
application_steps: Call for same-week availability or request an appointment online
what_to_bring: ID and insurance card if available; neither is required to ask for help

title: Mobile Care East Bay
description: Synthetic mobile clinic providing basic care, prescriptions navigation, and referrals at rotating community sites.
eligibility: Open to youth ages 16-25; no fixed address required
application_steps: Check the weekly mobile schedule or call
what_to_bring: No documents required for basic services

title: East Bay Ride Forward
description: Synthetic transit support providing trip planning and limited-value transit cards for appointments, work, and school.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 16-25; card supply varies
application_steps: Call for a trip-planning appointment and ask about card availability
what_to_bring: Appointment, school, or work destination information

title: Contra Costa Wheels to Work
description: Synthetic transportation coaching and limited ride credits for employment and training.
eligibility: Youth ages 18-25 starting or maintaining work or training
application_steps: Complete a short phone intake and share the trip need
what_to_bring: Work or training schedule if available

title: Community Table Pantry
description: Synthetic low-barrier food pantry with groceries, hygiene supplies, and benefits application assistance.
eligibility: Open to community members; youth may visit without a referral
application_steps: Visit during distribution hours or call for a pickup accommodation
what_to_bring: Bags if available; no documents required for groceries

title: East Bay Community Fridge Map
description: Synthetic live directory of free community refrigerators and meal sites.
eligibility: Open access; individual sites may have different hours
application_steps: Open the map and confirm the site note before traveling
what_to_bring: Nothing required

title: Documents and ID Clinic
description: Synthetic clinic helping youth understand how to replace state IDs, birth certificates, and Social Security cards.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 16-25
application_steps: Reserve a clinic appointment or call for document triage
what_to_bring: Bring any copies or photos of existing documents if available

title: Know Your Work Rights
description: Synthetic legal information and referral service for wage, scheduling, discrimination, and workplace-safety concerns.
eligibility: California workers ages 16-25
application_steps: Call the information line or complete a secure callback form
what_to_bring: Pay stubs, schedule, or written messages if available

title: Peer Circle East Bay
description: Synthetic peer-led groups, social events, and one-to-one mentorship for current and former foster youth.
eligibility: Current or former foster youth ages 16-26
application_steps: Choose a group or request a mentor match
what_to_bring: Nothing required

title: Life Skills Kitchen and Home Lab
description: Synthetic hands-on workshops for cooking, renting, budgeting, laundry, and basic home maintenance.
eligibility: Youth ages 16-25
application_steps: Register for one workshop or the four-week series
what_to_bring: Nothing required; materials provided
hours: Tue and Thu evenings; Sat mornings

title: National Foster Youth Hotline
description: Synthetic 24/7 navigation line for urgent placement, runaway, trafficking, and safety concerns.
eligibility: Current and former foster youth and people supporting them
application_steps: Call or text; say whether it is safe to speak
what_to_bring: Nothing required
